newsitem.title: YEMEN: Saudi interior minister to visit Yemen this week.
newsitem.headline: Saudi interior minister to visit Yemen this week.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's interior minister will visit Yemen this week to discuss bilateral relations and efforts to resolve a 61-year border row between the two countries, a Yemeni official said on Sunday.

"Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef bin Abdul-Aziz will visit Yemen in the next two days to relay a message from King Fahd to Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh," the official who asked not to be named told Reuters.
He said the Saudi minister would discuss with his Yemeni counterpart "security issues of bilateral interest".

Yemen, one of the region's poorest countries, and oil-rich Saudi Arabia signed a memorandum of understanding in 1995 to resolve the border dispute. A joint committee looking into border demarcation has met scores of times since then, but its work is moving at a snail's pace, diplomats say.

Yemen has hinted in recent months it might resort to international arbitration. The two countries had several minor clashes in a border area potentially rich in oil and gas before they signed the deal.
